lines.l: You better learn and love this life, cause there's things
There's things that are hard to see
And as I sat there thinking once again, he turned to me
And said, I've given no temptation, but those things
Those things have got to go
So I just sat and listened to what Jesus said to me
Cause sometimes you gotta listen if there's things
If there's things you just can't see
While we were, I walked in once again, he turned to me
And as I looked into his eyes, his thoughts
His thoughts just came to me
Well, some people never listen, you know
But I can see and hear these things
These things have gone too early
